sources.publisher: SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, SBI VC Trade and Startale
claims: JPYSC began initial service inside SBI VC Trade accounts only.
The announcement said public-chain circulation would follow after relevant legal and tax practices were clarified.
SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is the issuer; SBI VC Trade handles distribution.
limitations: The exact internal ledger or chain used for the initial account-limited service is not identified in the cited announcement.
Do not equate SBI's later 'on-chain balance' wording with public XRPL, Base, Ethereum or Arc circulation.

claims: SBI Holdings and Startale joined Open Standard, whose participants include Coinbase and more than 140 companies.
SBI and Startale said they were considering a proof of concept for interoperability between JPYSC and Open USD (OUSD).
The announcement conditions the work on OUSD's on-chain availability and applicable legal requirements.
limitations: The announcement describes a proposed PoC, not a completed integration or production settlement.
Coinbase is named as an Open Standard founding partner; this does not prove a direct bilateral Coinbase-JPYSC integration.

claims: SBI Holdings and Startale signed an MOU with BlackRock entities to explore a tokenized money-market-fund and JPYSC digital-asset ecosystem.
limitations: An MOU is exploratory and does not establish an issued tokenized fund, deployed settlement rail or capital allocation.

claims: ADNOC's CEO said nearly one billion barrels had been drawn from global inventories since the Strait of Hormuz disruption.
The report described diesel inventories in some regions at 35-year seasonal lows and an LNG supply gap of approximately 600 billion cubic feet.
The report placed Brent near USD 110 per barrel, approximately 50% above its prewar February level.
limitations: The inventory and LNG figures are attributed to the named executive and should be treated as sourced claims, not independently reconstructed balances.
The report does not identify an XRP-specific transmission channel.

claims: At 09:00 GMT on November 2, Brent was reported down 3.7% to USD 109.23 and WTI down 3.8% to USD 100.14 amid renewed US-Iran negotiation hopes.
limitations: This is a timestamp-specific observation; later providers reported different prices and percentage moves. Do not average non-synchronized quotes.

hypotheses.statement: If JPYSC/OUSD interoperability becomes production, it could provide a direct yen-dollar stablecoin settlement route and reduce the need for XRP as a bridge on some JPY/USD corridors.
support: SBI and Startale announced they are considering a JPYSC/OUSD interoperability PoC.
Coinbase is a founding Open Standard partner.
disconfirming: No completed PoC, public-chain JPYSC circulation, OUSD route volume or XRP corridor baseline is disclosed.

hypotheses.statement: SBI's JPYSC/BlackRock MOU could connect yen stablecoin settlement to tokenized money-market-fund distribution and treasury workflows.
support: Official MOU announcement names tokenized MMF and JPYSC ecosystem exploration.
disconfirming: No issued fund token, subscriptions, redemptions or settlement volume are disclosed.

hypotheses.statement: Energy supply disruption can transmit to crypto through inflation expectations, central-bank rate expectations, USD funding and global risk appetite; November 2 oil declines may reflect de-escalation repricing while physical supply buffers remain depleted.
support: Reuters reports large inventory drawdowns and constrained diesel/LNG buffers.
Reuters reports oil fell on negotiation hopes.
disconfirming: No measured XRP-specific sensitivity or causal event study is supplied in this artifact.
Oil-price observations are timestamp-specific and news-driven; other macro variables may dominate.

critical_distinctions: JPYSC's November 2 handled balance is on-chain balance plus SBI VC Trade lending balance; it is not equivalent to publicly transferable circulating supply.
SBI's June 24 launch announcement says initial availability was restricted to SBI VC Trade accounts and public-chain circulation was deferred pending legal/tax arrangements.
The exact chain or ledger behind the initial JPYSC account service is unknown; do not label it XRPL, Base, Ethereum or Arc.
Open Standard membership, an interoperability PoC, an MOU and a production settlement route are four different evidence states.
Oil price changes on November 2 must be stored as provider/timestamp-specific observations, not averaged into one daily fact.

forecast.reason: No completed JPYSC/OUSD integration, no public JPYSC ledger series, no ACI production corridor volumes and no calibrated XRP macro response model are available.

next_actions: Verify whether any JPYSC public-chain deployment or exact chain identifier is announced after the initial account-limited launch.
Track Open Standard PoC milestones and distinguish membership from live OUSD/JPYSC settlement.
Track BlackRock MOU milestones separately from tokenized MMF issuance and actual fund assets.
Build timestamped oil, gas, shipping, inflation-expectation, USD and JPY rate features before testing XRP macro sensitivity.
Retain an explicit no-XRP-link finding unless a primary source or on-chain trace establishes a direct relationship.
